run_ehull_cli: run the ehull CLI to compute e-hull per atom for prerelaxed crystal structures from a JSON dataframe
run_get_dft_results: run get_dft_results to parse .traj files in a directory and extract DFT energy per atom into a DataFrame
run_get_e_hull_from_phase_diagram: run get_e_hull_from_phase_diagram to compute the hull energy per atom for a given crystal structure
run_get_record: run get_record to extract energy, forces, and atom count from a single ASE trajectory file
run_get_patched_phase_diagram_mp: run get_patched_phase_diagram_mp to load a pickled Materials Project PatchedPhaseDiagram from a file path
